metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: guard hooks, a development workflow (issues, PR reviews, sessions), test design, repo bootstrapping, image and video creation, diagrams as code, artifact linters, an inventory database, instruction files loaded like CLAUDE.md, X research skills, two-way messaging with other AI agents, and Japan-specific HR certificates

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Hooks that block destructive Bash commands, deleting unmerged worktrees and pushing from a stale branch, and fast-forward the local base branch after a merge. Also blocks gh issue view --comments without --json (gh-comments-guard) and pip freeze (pip-freeze-guard), and optionally checks issue / PR text written through gh or the GitHub connector against your private-value patterns before it is published to a public repo (publish-guard; see the plugin README for what it does not see). Optional repo-layout rules

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for the path from request to merge (including PR review routing and waiting), issue hygiene, session handoff and runbook recording, plus a mod that writes usage limits to a file

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Skills and hooks for designing and running tests: Gherkin test cases, test-artifact linting and a full-test gate

plugins.name: repo-setup
plugins.description: Skills for bootstrapping a repo: a health check of the basics, a cloud-environment setup scaffold and a builder for a project's real-app verification skill

plugins.name: creative
plugins.description: Skills for image-generation prompts with an image history (SQLite, or Postgres/Supabase directly or through a connector) and code-driven motion videos

plugins.name: diagram
plugins.description: Skills for drawing diagrams as code: one-page explanatory diagrams whose element kinds stay consistent, and notation-bound diagrams (flowchart, sequence, state, ER, C4) in Mermaid or as polished SVG, with a stepper that walks through several points on one figure

plugins.name: lint
plugins.description: Tools for making skills: skill-planner plans a skill before it is built, and skill-lint checks whether it is safe to distribute. Also a hook that lints DESIGN.md after it is edited

plugins.name: inventory
plugins.description: An inventory database of the things you own: register items from photos, keep what could not be read as needs_review, and search with NFKC-normalized text. SQLite by default, or Postgres/Supabase directly or through a claude.ai connector

plugins.name: instructions
plugins.description: A mod that loads bundled instruction files the way Claude Code loads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. Currently one file on reply language and linking files

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Skills that read X and the web. Currently research-x, which summarizes update announcements from X accounts you choose and posts them to Slack

plugins.name: hr
plugins.description: Japan-specific HR and labour admin. Currently employee-certificate, which fills the certificates a company issues to an employee (the employment certificate for nursery and after-school applications on the municipality's Excel form, proof of enrolment, separation certificates, proof of income) by item label, from company and employee files you keep outside the plugin

plugins.name: agent-bridge
plugins.description: Two-way messaging between Claude Code and other AI agents through a message queue you host on Supabase: one API for every agent, woken by webhook or polling, plus a setup skill that builds the bridge with placeholder Vault secrets
